#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int n;
vector<char> chars;
vector<int> vals;

struct Char {
    char chr;
    int val;
    int idx;
    Char(char c, int v, int i) : chr(c), val(v), idx(i) {}
};

bool isAntiPalindrome(const vector<char>& chs) {
    int len = chs.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
        if (chs[i] == chs[len - i - 1]) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void swapChars(vector<char>& chs, vector<int>& vls, int i) {
    swap(chs[i], chs[n - i - 1]);
    swap(vls[i], vls[n - i - 1]);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> n;
    cin.ignore();
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    s.erase(s.begin(), s.begin() + s.find_first_not_of(" \t\n\r\f\v")); // trim
    chars = vector<char>(s.begin(), s.end());

    vals.resize(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> vals[i];
    }
    cin.ignore();

    vector<Char> wrongChars;
    vector<Char> chars1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
        if (vals[i] > vals[n - i - 1]) {
            swapChars(chars, vals, i);
        }
        Char chr(chars[i], vals[i], i);
        if (chars[i] == chars[n - i - 1]) {
            wrongChars.push_back(chr);
        }
        chars1.push_back(chr);
    }
    sort(chars1.begin(), chars1.end(), [](const Char& a, const Char& b) {
        return a.val < b.val;
    });

    int diff = 0;
    if (!isAntiPalindrome(chars)) {
        if (wrongChars.size() == 1) {
            Char wrongChar = wrongChars[0];
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                Char chr = chars1[i];
                if (chr.chr != wrongChar.chr && chars[n - chr.idx - 1] != wrongChar.chr) {
                    diff = wrongChar.val + chr.val;
                    break;
                }
            }
        } else if (wrongChars.size() > 1) {
            unordered_map<char, int> map;
            for (const auto& c : wrongChars) {
                map[c.chr]++;
            }
            auto max_it = max_element(map.begin(), map.end(), [](const pair<char,int>& a, const pair<char,int>& b) {
                return a.second < b.second;
            });
            char maxChar = max_it->first;
            vector<Char> append;
            while (max_it->second * 2 > (int)wrongChars.size() + (int)append.size()) {
                for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) {
                    Char chr = chars1[i];
                    if (chr.chr != maxChar && chars[n - chr.idx - 1] != maxChar && 
                        find(wrongChars.begin(), wrongChars.end(), chr) == wrongChars.end() &&
                        find(append.begin(), append.end(), chr) == append.end()) {
                        append.push_back(chr);
                        break;
                    }
                }
                max_it = max_element(map.begin(), map.end(), [](const pair<char,int>& a, const pair<char,int>& b) {
                    return a.second < b.second;
                });
                maxChar = max_it->first;
            }
            int sumWrong = 0;
            for (const auto& c : wrongChars) sumWrong += c.val;
            int sumAppend = 0;
            for (const auto& c : append) sumAppend += c.val;
            diff = sumWrong + sumAppend;
        }
    }

    int sumVals = accumulate(vals.begin(), vals.end(), 0);
    cout << sumVals - diff << "\n";

    return 0;
}
